en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course Bioinformatics focuses on bioinformatic analyses in the areas of image analysis, advanced statistical methods, and analysis of genomic and transcriptomic data. Students will be introduced to the university license of the Matlab program and python programming language.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Bioinformatics and Programming (allowance 1/1) a.Basic Conceptsb.Definition of the Studyc.Programming Languages and Programs for Bioinformatics Analyses2.Objects in Programming and Operations with Them (allowance 1/1) a.Variables, Strings, Vectors, Matrices, Tensors, and Operationsb.Commands, Cycles, Scripts3.Matlab (allowance 1/3) a.Tools and Extensions of Basic Functions – Statistics Toolbox, Bioinformatics Toolboxb.Comparison and Analysis of Nucleic Acid and Protein Sequencesc.Phylogenetic Trees4.Image Analysis (allowance 1/3) a.Processing, Editing, and Analysis of Images (ImageJ, Matlab)b.Automated Analysis (ImageJ, Java)c.Analysis of Hyperspectral Data (Matlab)5.Fundamentals of Statistics for Bioinformatics 1 (allowance 1/2) a.Probabilityb.Data Distributionsc.Estimationsd.ANOVA and Nonparametric Tests6.Fundamentals of Statistics for Bioinformatics 2 (allowance 1/2) a.Regression Modelsb.Correlationc.FDR and Benjamini-Hochberg Correction7.Data Complexity Reduction and Identification of Key Factors (allowance 1/2) a.PCA/ICAb.OPLSc.LDA8.Introduction to Systems Biology (allowance 1/2) a.Boolean Networksb.Enzyme Kinetics and Basics of Metabolism Modelingc.Jacobi Matrix9.GWAS (allowance 1/2) a.Basic Principlesb.GWAS in Practise10.Analysis of RNA-seq (allowance 1/2) a.Measurement of Gene Expression, Normalization, Summarization, and Differential Expressionb.Identification of Transcriptional Variants - Alternative Splicing11.Machine Learning (allowance 1/2) a.Machine Learning Methodsb.Deep Learning in Python12.Image Analysis Using Machine Learning (allowance 1/2) a.Preparing of Database and Labelingb.Classification by Neural Network
